raw_response:
This little plot is my enset and some fruit trees, and I have been tending it for many years. I do not have money to spare for the fertilizer from the cooperative, and my enset has always grown well with the manure from our cattle that I spread around the base of the plants. At my age I mostly do the light work myself — weeding, mulching, harvesting — and my children help me when the heavier work is needed, but I do not hire anyone. The rain here is enough; I have never watered this plot from a channel.
